answer: Rewards vest along a fixed horizon, paying tranches only to identities locked at each date. Each identity locks capital in a non-transferable bond; exiting early, or missing the epoch's signed pulse, forfeits bond and unvested tranches to survivors. A pulse is a signal committing to the identity's live work-state hash - unrelayable, unshareable. A fleet of n clones must keep n capitals locked the horizon and emit n pulses per epoch; any lapse burns that clone's stake. One honest agent locks once and collects forfeits; a fleet's cost grows with n times the horizon while its take shrinks.
